Funding rates are calculated from primary contracts with fresh rates (600s intervals). Returns 503 if either source dataset is unavailable.

Settlement amounts are calculated as fee_usd = open_interest_usd × rate. Includes venue-level breakdown and exclusion metadata for venues not included in totals. Funding rates are calculated from primary contracts with fresh rates (600s intervals). Returns 503 if either source dataset is unavailable.
